method: Official documentation searched and opened during the restart audit. Observations are paraphrases; client versions and authenticated account state were not captured.

sources.observation: ProtoJSON parsers accept lowerCamelCase and original proto field names. Inference: Gemini retrieval path components can use aliases independently; filtering only homogeneous paths leaves six mixed combinations.

tools.web_search permits optional location with country, region, city and timezone. Custom model providers support http_headers and env_http_headers. Documented removal of optional location and the existing Router provider's explicit consent header; no universal geolocation-off control is established.
ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS supports newline-separated Name: Value pairs. User settings can supply environment variables. Keep other required headers while adding or removing Router's consent header.

Optional coarse product location for consumer Claude plans, including their Claude Code use, has privacy controls. Mandatory security and abuse-prevention country/region inference cannot be turned off. No authenticated account setting was changed.
Web search accepts optional approximate user_location; retaining search while removing that metadata is possible. IP-derived and account location are outside this metadata contract.
